title: visualy immersive
description: a collection of mods to make the visuals sound and other aspects of minecraft more immersive
body:
![title](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e4fc88886cd0ca2012a730718fc6398dc81c85fd.png)
this is my first modpack hope you injoy if you decide to use it. this modpack is supposed to make your game look feel and sound more immersive it includes some mods such as 

-  all of the yungs better mods
- do a bearl roll
- sound physics remasterd
- dungeons and taverns
- better end

and many more
heres a video i made couse i can
